{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
revenue_clean = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = revenue_clean == 999999.99
num_qa_rows = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter out QA rows
valid_df = df[~qa_mask]

# Now count completed orders in valid data
completed_orders = valid_df[valid_df['status'] == 'completed']
count_completed = len(completed_orders)

print(f"Number of QA rows: {num_qa_rows}")
print(f"Number of completed orders (excluding QA): {count_completed}")"}
